build_method: Option B (hybrid HTML overlay). Revision history: v1 (b3cd8b2) was a night storefront exterior with only a celeste accent in the text layer. v2 (ea3af4a) fixed that with a moody night-lit barbershop interior plus a Guatemalan flag as the one full-color element. v3 (55ba4fb): client found v2 'aburrido'/'oscuro', so backgrounds went full natural color with bright daylight and papel picado bunting. v4 (f7c00df): client asked to remove the decorations and show the flag 'como es' (accurately) and larger -- flag got the real national coat of arms (quetzal, scroll, crossed rifles and swords, laurel wreath) and became dominant, but was generated billowing at a diagonal angle. v5 (this revision): client said 'no me gusta como pusiste la bandera haz que se note mas'; asked what specifically, client confirmed it was the angle -- wanted the flag straight-on and complete in frame, not diagonal/cropped. Backgrounds regenerated with scripts/kie_image_gen.mjs (feed 3:4/2K, story 9:16/2K): flag now mounted on a straight, perfectly vertical wooden pole, fabric hanging flat and facing the camera directly (no billowing, no diagonal drape), fully visible within the frame with nothing cropped by any edge -- same accurate coat of arms as v4. First regeneration attempt at this straighter flag pose also pushed the barber chair down into the bottom third/half of the frame, where the text scrim's dark gradient hid it entirely (undoing the earlier 'this reads as a barbershop' fix) -- caught on visual review and fixed with one more regeneration pass that explicitly pins the chair's headrest to roughly the vertical center of the frame, clear of the scrim zone; that intermediate attempt is kept for reference at raw/bg-v5-bandera-recta-silla-tapada*.png. design-system.md's duotone/gold-key-light photography rule remains deliberately set aside for this one commemorative piece (established in v3), same spirit as the color exceptions precedented in mundial-bandera-argentina/ and dia-partido-camiseta/, just extended to the full frame instead of one element. All prior background versions are kept for reference under raw/: bg-v1-exterior*.png, bg-v2-night-barbershop*.png, bg-v3-papel-picado*.png, bg-v4-bandera-angulada*.png, bg-v5-bandera-recta-silla-tapada*.png. Text/logo layer is real HTML+CSS (index.html / index-story.html), unchanged since v2: celeste (#4997D0) pill, headline highlight word, and a thin celeste/bone/celeste flag-rule divider under the headline, echoing the flag's own colors. Rendered to PNG via headless Chrome at --force-device-scale-factor=2 (1080x1350 -> 2160x2700 feed, 1080x1920 -> 2160x3840 story). This is a purely commemorative post (no hours, no price, no booking CTA) -- distinct from the operational posts/instagram/horario-especial-15-septiembre/ post about special hours on the same date; do not merge or confuse the two.
headline: Orgullosamente / Guatemaltecos
